title: Pyne Pod Blue Razz GB Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pyne Pod NicSalts Blue Razz GB 10ml E-Liquid offers a deeply sweet and highly nostalgic vaping experience. This flavour opens with the bold, syrupy notes of rich Blue Raspberry, creating a vibrant and fruity inhale. This is flawlessly blended with the chewy, sugary taste of classic Gummy Bear confectionery on the exhale, resulting in a perfectly balanced sweet shop profile that remains consistently rich from start to finish. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Pyne Pod Nic Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Pyne Pod Nic Salts collection translates the intense, highly popular flavours of their renowned prefilled pods into a versatile 10ml format. Offering a more cost-effective and flexible alternative, the range covers a wide variety of tastes. Beyond the sugary delight of Blue Razz GB, vapers can explore other irresistible blends such as the sharp citrus of Cola Lime, the rich forest fruits of Blueberry Raspberry, or the frosty chill of Strawberry Ice.
